title: High-Resolution Probabilistic Data-Driven Weather Modeling with a Stretched-Grid
abstract: arXiv:2511.23043v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present a probabilistic data-driven weather model providing ensembles of high spatial resolution realizations of 87 variables at arbitrary ensemble size and forecast length. The model uses a global stretched grid, dedicating 2.5 km resolution to our Nordic region of interest and 31 km resolution elsewhere, with 6-hour temporal resolution. Unique ensemble members are generated by a stochastic model architecture, and we train it using a loss function based on the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) evaluated in grid-point and spectral space. The spectral loss component is shown to be necessary to create fields that are spatially coherent, which is not the case when training with mean-squared error loss, nor CRPS in grid-point space only. We evaluate the forecasts against observations from surface weather stations and compare them to high-resolution operational numerical weather prediction forecasts from the MetCoOp Ense

translated_title: 基于拉伸网格的高分辨率概率数据驱动天气建模
translated_abstract: 摘要：我们提出了一种概率数据驱动天气模型，能够以任意集合规模和预测长度，提供87个变量的高空间分辨率实现集合。该模型采用全球拉伸网格，为我们关注的北欧地区提供2.5公里分辨率，其他区域为31公里分辨率，时间分辨率为6小时。独特的集合成员通过随机模型架构生成，我们使用基于连续排名概率得分（CRPS）的损失函数进行训练，该损失函数在格点和谱空间中进行评估。谱损失成分被证明对于生成空间连贯的场是必要的，而使用均方误差损失或仅在格点空间使用CRPS训练时则无法实现这一点。我们将预测结果与地面气象站的观测数据进行了评估，并与MetCoOp Ense的高分辨率业务数值天气预报进行了比较。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于拉伸网格的概率数据驱动天气模型，通过谱空间CRPS损失函数生成空间连贯的高分辨率集合预测，实现了北欧地区2.5公里分辨率下的有效天气建模。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a probabilistic data-driven weather model using a stretched grid, where a spectral-space CRPS loss function enables spatially coherent high-resolution ensemble forecasts at 2.5 km resolution over the Nordic region.
